source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/test_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Inspect source schemas:
# Source0 columns: ['right_index', '0']
# Source1 columns: ['0']
# Target schema: ['0_x', '0_y'] both float

# Transformation plan:
# - Source0 has 'right_index' and '0' columns.
# - Source1 has only '0' column.
# - Target has two columns '0_x' and '0_y' which correspond to the '0' column from Source0 and Source1 respectively.
# - The 'right_index' in Source0 can be used as a key to join with Source1's index (which is 0-based row index).
# - Source1 has 500 rows, Source0 has 1000 rows.
# - Target has 500 rows, so we will join Source0 and Source1 on Source0.right_index == Source1.index, then select only those rows where join is possible (inner join).
# - Rename Source0 '0' to '0_x' and Source1 '0' to '0_y'.

# Join Source0 and Source1 on Source0.right_index == Source1.index
# Note: Source1 index is the row index (0 to 499)

# Filter Source0 to only rows where right_index < 500 to match Source1 index range

# df1 '0' -> '0_y'

target_df['0_y'] = target_df['0_y'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
